title: MSME Ministry, DPIIT Sign MoU for GI Product Market Access
summary: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade signed a Memorandum of Understanding on 5 August 2026 at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi, for wider market access for Geographical...

blocks.content: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade signed a Memorandum of Understanding on 5 August 2026 at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi, for wider market access for Geographical Indication products. The MoU links the MSME Ministry’s enterprise support systems with the legal and administrative framework of the DPIIT under the Geographical Indications of Goods Act, 1999.

items: Geographical Indication tags are used for products linked to a specific place, such as Darjeeling Tea and Kanchipuram Silk Saree.
The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 provides legal protection to GI products in India.
